headline.phenotype_label: Lean Metabolically Excellent · Atopic overlay · Circadian-shifted
headline.voice: Peer, future-focused. Top-decile metabolic profile at 25 — every chassis (lipids, glucose, liver, kidney, thyroid) is humming. The work is at three edges: one severe Vit D deficiency, one atopic-and-possibly-parasitic eosinophil signal needing workup, one circadian shift. This is sharpening, not fixing.
headline.longevity_baseline_note: 4 grandparents past 85 — top-decile genetic longevity baseline.

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 1 — Vitamin D restoration (the single highest-leverage move)
root_attack_pillars.why_this_pillar: Sits upstream of 3 of your 4 sub-optimal findings: atopy (Th2 bias), relative-low T (steroidogenic cofactor), borderline RDW (immune modulation). Move this one number and three others normalize.
anchor_interventions: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU/week × 8-12 weeks with fatty meal (physician supervised)
AM sunlight 15 min/day on forearms — Hyderabad before 10am or after 4pm

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 2 — Circadian shift + sleep architecture (T-optimization lever)
root_attack_pillars.why_this_pillar: Your AM cortisol 20 is not chronic stress (PSS-4 = 4) — it's a phase-shifted curve from late dinner (11pm-12am) + late bedtime (~1am). T peaks in deep-sleep windows. Compress these and T rises.
anchor_interventions: Move dinner to 8-9pm (drop 3 hours earlier from current 11pm-12am)
Anchor bedtime by 11pm-midnight; anchor wake by 7-8am
15-min AM sunlight within 30 min of waking
Phone out of bedroom; screen curfew 30 min before sleep (currently 8-9h daily screen)
Magnesium glycinate 300mg at bedtime (also helps onset latency 20-40min)

root_attack_pillars.name: Pillar 3 — Atopic + parasitic workup (parallel medical track)
root_attack_pillars.why_this_pillar: Eosinophils 9.4% with confirmed seasonal rhinitis + recent travel to Bihar (rural India) + Thailand. You can't assume which it is — must test.
anchor_interventions: **Medical referral**: Primary care for stool ova-and-parasite (O&P) panel — rule out helminths/giardia post-Bihar travel. Cheap and definitive.
**Medical referral**: Allergist consult if rhinitis severity rises above 6/10, OR if AEC stays elevated at Day-90 retest. Specific-IgE panel (dust mite, pollen, mold).
HEPA filter in bedroom — Hyderabad winter pollen + dust mite
Shower before bed during high-pollen seasons (Aug-Sep, Nov-Feb)
expected_to_shift: rhinitis severity → <2/10 with avoidance + Vit D

leading_principles: Your existing diet is solid (chicken + roti + curries + protein shake + low alcohol + low caffeine). 3 surgical shifts:
1. MOVE DINNER 3 HOURS EARLIER. Currently 11pm-12am → target 8-9pm. This is the single biggest non-supplement lever for T + cortisol + sleep architecture.
2. COMPRESS EATING WINDOW. Currently 13h (11am→12am) → target 10-11h (e.g., 11am→9pm). You stated 10h but actual is 13h — fix the math.
3. ADD ZINC + FATTY-FISH FREQUENCY. Salmon/mackerel 2×/week + 30g pumpkin seeds/day. Both support T + Vit D.

**Dinner (8:30pm — MOVED EARLIER)**: lighter — chicken or paneer (150g) + 2 rotis + 1 cup sabzi (palak/methi/lauki) + small bowl curd. Skip the protein shake at dinner — you've hit your daily protein already.
Salmon / mackerel 2×/wk replacing chicken at lunch or dinner

training.summary: Your training is already excellent. Two adjustments: more Zone 2 base, more NEAT outside the gym.

weekly_structure_target.zone_2_note: Currently long run every 2 weeks → bump to weekly. Add 2× 30-min easy bike/treadmill at conversational pace. Target 120-150 min Zone 2/wk.
weekly_structure_target.mobility: 10 min daily — yoga or dynamic flow

neat_steps_target.note: Single biggest non-gym training change. Add 20-min post-lunch walk + 10-min post-dinner walk + 1 phone call/day walking. Easy to find 5k more steps in flexible schedule.

twelve_week_plan.additions: Move dinner to 9pm. Add 1× weekly long Zone 2 (60 min). NEAT to 6k/day.
Zone 2 to 90 min/wk (split into 2-3 sessions). NEAT to 8k/day. Keep strength + HIIT.
Zone 2 to 120 min/wk. Add 1× VO2max session (4×4 min hard intervals). Keep PPL.
Hold all habits. Week 12: fast 12h, no caffeine 24h, no alcohol 72h before retest.

training.rationale: You have insulin sensitivity (HOMA-IR 0.74) without the Zone 2 base. Building Zone 2 mitochondrial density lowers RHR, improves HRV, supports T optimization, and adds healthspan years — for someone with 4 grandparents past 85, this is the big lifelong lever.

recovery_sleep.headline: Your sleep quality is good (7-8/10) — the issue is the CLOCK, not the architecture. Shift the whole schedule 2-3 hours earlier.
wind_down_protocol: 21:00-22:00: screen curfew — no laptop/phone (use red-light glasses if reading on phone)
22:00: 5-10 min slow breathing (4-7-8 or physiological sigh) — anchors parasympathetic
07:00: wake + 15 min AM sunlight within 30 min (Hyderabad balcony or short walk)
environment_fixes: Room temp: aim for 22-24°C (use AC or fan; currently 'moderate-warm' — temperature drives sleep architecture)
Light: blackout curtains if not present
Phone: out of bedroom (charge in another room)
HEPA filter in bedroom (also helps atopic)
recovery_sleep.expected_outcome: Sleep onset 20-40 min → <15 min; consistent 8h at correct phase; AM cortisol normalizes; T pulses optimized; mood + cognition compound benefits.
